brief:
A circulating alert has warned Gaza residents that mobile SIM cards may have been registered with Jawwal and Ooredoo using their national ID numbers without their knowledge, Shehab Wire reported. The unauthorized registrations could enable fraudsters to use the cards for scams or financial crimes tied to the victims' identities.

The warning urged residents to verify their accounts with both carriers and report any suspicious registrations to prevent potential misuse.

title: Gaza residents warned of SIM cards registered in their names without consent
